xrefdescription.para: BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, LLMResponseGeneration) Measure: prompt → response from LLM Assert: p95 < 3s, p99 < 10s GATE_LLM_LATENCY_P95 <= 3000ms GATE_LLM_LATENCY_P99 <= 10000ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, TTSSynthesis) Measure: text → audio from TTS Assert: < 2s for 50 word response GATE_TTS_SYNTHESIS <= 2000ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, EndToEndLatency) Measure: audio-in → audio-out (full assistant latency) Assert: p95 < 6s (1s audio + 2s STT + 3s LLM/TTS) GATE_E2E_LATENCY_P95 <= 6000ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, CommandParsingAndRouting) Measure: identify command + route to handler Assert: < 100ms GATE_COMMAND_PARSE <= 100ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, CommandResponseGeneration) Measure: command → response generation (excluding TTS) Assert: < 500ms
BENCHMARK(VoiceAssistant, MultiCommandSequence) Measure: sequence of rapid commands (e.g., "play", "pause", "next") Assert: < 500ms each in sequence

briefdescription.para: Google Benchmark suite for Voice assistant end-to-end latency.

detaileddescription.para:
Benchmarks:
GATE_LLM_LATENCY_P95 <= 3000ms
GATE_LLM_LATENCY_P99 <= 10000ms
GATE_TTS_SYNTHESIS <= 2000ms
GATE_E2E_LATENCY_P95 <= 6000ms
GATE_COMMAND_PARSE <= 100ms
